item.title: 32 People Charged With Burglary In Clare In First Nine Months Of 2025
item.description: Calls have been made for stiffer penalties to be handed out to those found guilty of repeat burglary offences, which it’s claimed disproportionately target older people in this county. New figures from the Irish Courts Service show 32 people appeared before local courts in Clare on burglary charges in the first nine months of 2025.
